name: Unitel Australia
summary: Wholesale network services arm of Commander Communications (Unitel Australia Pty Ltd, ex-RSL Com Partners, wholesaling since 1999; fixed/mobile/data to RSPs); acquired by M2 Telecommunications in Feb 2008 ($10m + up to $2.5m earnout).

events.details: Wholesale network services business (ex-RSL Com Partners), later Commander Communications wholesale arm (fixed/LAR, mobile, data to RSPs nationally).
M2 Telecommunications acquired Unitel Australia: binding sale announced 4 Feb 2008, completed 22 Feb 2008 (A$10m base + up to A$2.5m earnout over 36 months).
